name: ffp-transcendental
source:
Print Ln(0)
Print Ln(1)
Print Ln(2)
Print Exp(0)
Print Exp(1)
Print Pi#
Print 3^3
Print 0^(-1)

encoding.notes: Explicit Print=0x0476, Ln=0x077c, Exp=0x0786, Pi#=0x06d6, power=0xfff6, integer=0x003e, parentheses=0x0074/0x007c and big-endian literal fields. Independent of the production token table/encoder. The negative exponent is encoded as a raw signed integer.

evidence.notes: Results interpret the preserved fixed-point CORDIC log/exp routines and power's log-multiply-exp composition. Ln(0) returns the largest negative finite value; 0^(-1) saturates positively; finite-precision power need not produce an exact integer. Pi uses AMOS Open_MathLibraries' literal 0xc90fd942. The fixture is source analysis, not captured execution of AMOS or a particular Kickstart mathtrans version; library equivalence remains unverified.
